description: Scaffold the apps-script/ project folder and implement the server-side foundation: appsscript.json manifest configured for a web app + SpreadsheetApp scopes, Code.gs (doGet, include helper, SPREADSHEET_ID with active-spreadsheet fallback, member-tab list), DataService.gs (read each member tab; skip title row, header row, and fully-empty separator rows; normalize each task row into a JSON object; produce per-member summaries and chart-shaped aggregates; cache results 60s with CacheService), plus apps-script/README.md deployment guide and apps-script/.clasp.json.example. Existing Java files MUST NOT be modified.
steps: Create directory `apps-script/` at the repo root. Do not modify anything outside this folder.

Create `apps-script/appsscript.json` with: timeZone (e.g., 'Asia/Kolkata' since the team uses dd/mm/yy dates), runtimeVersion 'V8', exceptionLogging 'STACKDRIVER', webapp.access 'ANYONE_WITH_GOOGLE' and webapp.executeAs 'USER_DEPLOYING', and oauthScopes including 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.readonly', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.container.ui', and 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.external_request'. Validate it parses with `python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('apps-script/appsscript.json'))"`.

Create `apps-script/Code.gs`. It must contain: a top-of-file JSDoc comment explaining the file. A `SPREADSHEET_ID` constant (initial value an empty string with a comment telling the user to paste their sheet ID, or leave empty to use the active bound spreadsheet). A `MEMBER_SHEETS` constant array exactly: ['Isra','Sowmiya','Keerthana','Yogesh','Tamizharasi']. A `getSpreadsheet_()` private helper that returns `SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID)` when SPREADSHEET_ID is non-empty, otherwise returns `SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()`, throwing a clear error if neither works. A `doGet(e)` that returns `HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('Index').evaluate().setTitle('QA - Daily Status Dashboard').setXFrameOptionsMode(HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL)`. An `include(filename)` helper that returns `HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile(filename).getContent()`. A `getMembers()` server function (callable from client) returning the MEMBER_SHEETS array. A `getConfig()` returning `{ members: MEMBER_SHEETS, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }`.

Create `apps-script/DataService.gs`. It must contain JSDoc-commented functions: `getMemberTasks(memberName)` returns an array of normalized task objects for a single member, fields exactly `{ sNo, date, client, projectName, hours, billability, status, bugCaptured, noOfBugs, bugsDescription }`. Date is converted to ISO yyyy-mm-dd (handle both Date objects and strings like '18/08/25' - parse dd/mm/yy assuming 20yy). Hours coerced to number (default 0). billability and status uppercased and trimmed. Skip row 1 (title), row 2 (header), and any data row where every cell in columns A-J is empty/blank (those are the teal separator rows). Validate the sheet exists; if not throw 'Sheet "<name>" not found'. `getAllTasks()` returns an object mapping each member name to its tasks array. `getMemberSummary(memberName)` returns `{ member, totalTasks, totalHours, billableHours, completedCount, inProgressCount, totalBugs, distinctClients }` (distinctClients is a number). `getAllSummaries()` returns an array of per-member summaries plus a 'totals' aggregate. `getChartData()` returns `{ hoursPerMember: [{member,hours}], statusBreakdown: [{label,value}] for COMPLETED vs IN-PROGRESS over all members, hoursPerDay: { <member>: [{date,hours}], all: [{date,hours}] }, billableSplit: { billable, nonBillable }, bugsPerMember: [{member,bugs}] }`. Every public server function must be wrapped to read through `CacheService.getScriptCache()` keyed by function name + args, with `put(..., 60)` TTL; on cache miss read the sheet and store JSON; on any error fall through to fresh read so cache poisoning of a stale error never blocks the UI.

Create `apps-script/README.md`. Document: (a) what this is, (b) two deployment paths - bound to the QA - Daily Status sheet via Extensions > Apps Script, vs standalone with SPREADSHEET_ID, (c) the exact list of files to create in the Apps Script editor in this order: appsscript.json (via Project Settings > Show appsscript.json), Code.gs, DataService.gs, Index.html, Banner.html, Stylesheet.html, Javascript.html, (d) Deploy > New deployment > Web app, executeAs Me, access Anyone with Google account, (e) how to update the team list (edit MEMBER_SHEETS in Code.gs and the buttons in Banner.html will pick it up automatically since they are rendered from getMembers()), (f) required OAuth scopes the user will be prompted to authorize, (g) cache TTL note (60s) and how to bust the cache by editing/redeploying.

Create `apps-script/.clasp.json.example` containing `{ "scriptId": "PASTE-YOUR-SCRIPT-ID-HERE", "rootDir": "." }` with a one-line README note that users who want to use clasp can copy this to `.clasp.json` and fill in the script ID. clasp is NOT required.

Verify: `python3 -c "import json,sys; json.load(open('apps-script/appsscript.json')); print('manifest ok')"` prints 'manifest ok'. Run `grep -nE 'function (doGet|include|getMembers|getConfig|getMemberTasks|getAllTasks|getMemberSummary|getAllSummaries|getChartData)\\b' apps-script/Code.gs apps-script/DataService.gs` and confirm all nine names appear. Run `grep -n 'CacheService' apps-script/DataService.gs` and confirm at least one match. Run `git diff --stat src/ bin/ README.md` and confirm output is empty (existing files untouched).
acceptance_criteria: `apps-script/appsscript.json` exists, is valid JSON, declares webapp config, V8 runtime, and SpreadsheetApp oauth scopes.
`apps-script/Code.gs` defines doGet, include, SPREADSHEET_ID, MEMBER_SHEETS (with the 5 names), getSpreadsheet_, getMembers, and getConfig.
`apps-script/DataService.gs` defines getMemberTasks, getAllTasks, getMemberSummary, getAllSummaries, getChartData and routes them through CacheService with a 60s TTL.
Empty separator rows and the title/header rows are explicitly skipped during sheet read; dd/mm/yy strings are parsed correctly.
`apps-script/README.md` documents both bound and standalone deployment, file order, web-app deployment steps, and how to update the member list.
No file outside `apps-script/` is added or modified.
verification: `grep -n 'MEMBER_SHEETS' apps-script/Code.gs` shows the array contains Isra, Sowmiya, Keerthana, Yogesh, Tamizharasi.
`git status --porcelain` shows only additions inside apps-script/ and inside .agents/tasks/.
findings: Implemented server-side foundation under apps-script/. Files added: appsscript.json (V8, webapp ANYONE_WITH_GOOGLE/USER_DEPLOYING, 4 oauth scopes), Code.gs (doGet, include, SPREADSHEET_ID, MEMBER_SHEETS=['Isra','Sowmiya','Keerthana','Yogesh','Tamizharasi'], getSpreadsheet_, getMembers, getConfig), DataService.gs (getMemberTasks/getAllTasks/getMemberSummary/getAllSummaries/getChartData all routed through withCache_ -> CacheService.getScriptCache() with 60s TTL; skips title/header/empty rows; normalizeDate_ handles Date objects, dd/mm/yy 2-digit-year=>20yy, dd/mm/yyyy and ISO), README.md (bound vs standalone, file order, deploy steps, scopes, cache TTL, member-list update flow), .clasp.json.example (placeholder scriptId). All FEAT-001 verification commands pass: manifest parses, all 9 required function names match grep, function doGet count=1, CacheService count=4 in DataService.gs, MEMBER_SHEETS contains all 5 names, git diff --stat src/ bin/ README.md is empty, git status shows only additions in apps-script/ and .agents/. No build/test runner exists for Apps Script - verification was static checks only as documented in context.json. FEAT-002 (HTML files: Index/Banner/Stylesheet/Javascript) intentionally not implemented in this feature.
